prompt: A photorealistic, murky still as seen by the lens of a phone leaning on a windowsill in a cramped English attic bedroom, the picture slightly overexposed where daylight leaks in and muddy everywhere else, shown as a plain full-bleed photograph with nothing drawn on top of it. Brandon, 22, a soft, pudgy young man with a round moon face, a double chin starting, patchy ginger-brown stubble that grows in clumps and leaves bare gaps along the jaw, and a hairline already retreating at the temples with thin hair combed forward over the forehead. He sits slumped at a wobbly desk in a stretched navy tracksuit top, crumbs on the chest, leaning close to the lens so his face fills much of the frame, eyebrows raised in earnest worry, a little sweat on the upper lip. Pale flat daylight from a grubby skylight above and behind him blows out the edge of the picture, and a cold blue cast from the screen he is reading lights the front of his face. Pink flushed cheeks, creased eyelids, slightly chapped skin, a mug ringed with tea stains and a heap of clothes on a chair behind him. Thanks.
